tests.name: assign scope
tests.template: {% with x=1 %}{% assign y = x + 1 %}{% endwith %}{{ y }}

tests.name: shadow
tests.template: {% assign x = 99 %}{{ x }}{% with x=1 %} {{ x }}{% endwith %} {{ x }}

tests.name: multiple arguments
tests.template: {% with x=1, y=2 %}{{ x }},{{ y }}{% endwith %}

tests.name: colon separated
tests.template: {% with x:1, y:2 %}{{ x }},{{ y }}{% endwith %}

tests.name: extra whitespace
tests.template:
{% with
  x=1,
  y=2
%}{{ x }},{{ y }}{% endwith %}

tests.name: later arguments can use earlier arguments
tests.template: {% with x = 1, y = x + 2 %}{{ x }},{{ y }}{% endwith %}

tests.name: short circuit logical or
tests.template: {% with x = foo or 1, y = x + 2 %}{{ x }},{{ y }}{% endwith %}

filtered argument
nested
tests.template: {% with x = 1 %}{% with y = 2 %}{{ x }} {{ y }}{% endwith %}{% endwith %}
